# Load Libraries

## Tidy vs Messy Data

![by Allison Horst](https://cdn.myportfolio.com/45214904-6a61-4e23-98d6-b140f8654a40/6e297111-efb7-4555-93d2-085071d1853c_rw_1920.jpg?h=f1951b118eaddaaab8a572422bc16566)

## Same data different structure{.smaller}


```{r}
#| label: tbl-show-tabl
#| tbl-cap: Same information can be presented in various forms
#| layout-ncol: 3
#| column: page

table1

table2

table3

```

## Try out

Can you make this chart from the data in `table1` and `table2`

```{r}
#| label: fig-cases-per-year
#| fig-cap: Number of cases per year
#| fig-dpi: 700
#| echo: false

table1 |>
    summarise(
        total = sum(cases),
        .by = year
    ) |>
        ggplot(aes(as.factor(year), total)) +
        geom_col(fill = "steelblue",
        width = .5) +
        labs(
            title = "Total cases in a year",
            y = "Number of cases",
            x = "year"
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "K",
        scale = 0.001)) +
        hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum()
```

# Lengthening Data

![from R4Ds](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/diagrams/tidy-data/variables.png)

## Lengthening Data


```{r}
#| label: tbl-show-pivot-long-motivate
#| tbl-cap: Which is in tidy format?
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| echo: false

table4a

table4a |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -country,names_to = "year",values_to = "cases")

```

## lengthening using `pivot_longer()` {auto-animate="true"}


```{r}
#| label: show-pivot-longer
#| code-line-numbers: "1"
#| output-location: column

table4a

```

## lengthening using `pivot_longer()` {auto-animate="true"}


```{r}
#| label: show-pivot-longer-2
#| code-line-numbers: "2,3,4,5"
#| output-location: column

table4a |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(2,3),
        names_to = "year",
        values_to = "cases"
    )

```

## Multiple Pieces in one column

![from R4DS](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/diagrams/tidy-data/multiple-names.png)

## lengthening data {.smaller auto-animate="true"}

**Multiple pieces in one col name**


```{r}
#| label: long-multiple-variable
#| output-location: column
#| code-line-numbers: "1"

who2
```

## lengthening data {.smaller auto-animate="true"}

**Multiple pieces in one col name**


```{r}
#| label: long-multiple-variable-2
#| output-location: column
#| code-line-numbers: "2,3,4,5,6,7"

who2 |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(country, year),
        names_to = c("diagnosis","gender","age"),
        names_sep = "_",
        values_to = "count"
    )
```

## lengthening data {.smaller auto-animate="true"}

**Multiple pieces in one col name**


```{r}
#| label: long-multiple-variable-3
#| output-location: column
#| code-line-numbers: "7"

who2 |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(country, year),
        names_to = c("diagnosis","gender","age"),
        names_sep = "_",
        values_to = "count",
        values_drop_na = T
    )
```

## Data and variable in column name

![from R4DS](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/diagrams/tidy-data/names-and-values.png)

## Data and variable in column name {.smaller auto-animate="true"}


```{r}
#| label: show-var-data-incol
#| code-line-numbers: "1"
#| output-location: column

household
```

## Data and variable in column name {.smaller auto-animate="true"}


```{r}
#| label: show-var-data-incol-2
#| code-line-numbers: "2,3,4,5,6,7"
#| output-location: column

household |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -family,
        names_to = c(".value", "child"),
        names_sep = "_",
        values_drop_na = T
    )
```

# Widening Data using `pivot_wider()`

## Widening Data {auto-animate="true"}

```{r}
#| label: show-widening
#| output-location: column
#| code-line-numbers: "1"

table2
```

## Widening Data {auto-animate="true"}

```{r}
#| label: show-widening-2
#| output-location: column
#| code-line-numbers: "2:5"

table2 |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = type,
        values_from = count
    )
```
